# Live the Dream Athletics

> A youth baseball program founded in 2001 by Kevan Burns: gloves for kids, clinics from Beloit to Panama, and players into college and pro ball. Today Live the Dream Athletics and NIL33 (fair, flat-fee NIL deals for athletes) are programs of UnyKorn LLC (Wyoming).

## Who
- Founder: Kevan Burns. Full sourced record: https://kevan.unykorn.ai
- Operator today: UnyKorn LLC, https://unykorn.ai
- Athlete side: NIL33, https://nil33.com

## Outside records of the program
- 2003 pro camp before the Tucson 24-hour women's game: https://whyilikebaseball.com/24-game-diary-pt-2/ and https://sabr.org/journal/article/i-dont-care-if-i-ever-get-back-marathons-lasting-20-or-more-innings/
- 2007 Beloit Daily News, a drafted player credits his swing work with Kevan: https://www.beloitdailynews.com/uncategorized/murphy-will-get-his-shot-at-pro-ball/article_d31b881b-210e-594f-ada3-91769a38e202.html

## Founder record (outside sources)
- Troy Trojans Baseball Hall of Fame, Class of 2007: https://issuu.com/troy_athletics/docs/_2022_media_guide/71
- NJCAA All-American, Indian Hills CC, 1998: https://indianhillsathletics.com/sports/bsb/all_americans
- Pro career 1999-2005: https://www.baseball-reference.com/register/player.fcgi?id=burns-001kev

## What this is not
Not a charity, investment or token. Gifts are not investments; supporter badges have no cash value.
